Accordion.summary: Disclosure component for vertically stacked question-and-answer or settings sections.
whenToUse: Let the reader collapse secondary content so the page stays scannable.
whenNotToUse: Content the reader almost always needs — show it instead of hiding it.
Switching between peer views — use Tabs.

Alert.summary: Inline feedback message for informational, successful, warning, and destructive states.
whenToUse: Deliver an in-page message about the state of the view or a task.
whenNotToUse: A decision that must block the flow — use a Dialog.
A toast notification: no toast component is exported; use inline Alert or request an extension.

Alert Dialog.summary: Modal confirmation surface for consequential actions.
whenToUse: Confirm a consequential action with explicit cancel and confirm choices.
whenNotToUse: General forms or custom focused tasks: use Dialog.
Nonblocking feedback: use Alert.
constraints: Consequential confirmation with explicit cancel/confirm callbacks. Description is required; backdrop does not dismiss. This is not a general content modal.
Initial focus goes to Cancel. Escape invokes onCancel; the caller closes controlled open state. Use destructive only for irreversible loss.

Avatar.summary: Compact identity representation using initials and optional presence status.
whenToUse: Represent a person, account, or organisation compactly.
whenNotToUse: Decorative imagery, or a general-purpose image container.
constraints: Supply name independently of initials. decorative hides the identity image when nearby text already names it; status still has separate accessible text. Small typography is an internal scoped exception, not a consumer style.

whenToUse: A short status, count, or category label.
whenNotToUse: Interactive primary actions — use a Button.

whenToUse: Show where the current page sits in a hierarchy, and offer a way back up.
whenNotToUse: Flat sites with no hierarchy.
Step-by-step progress through a flow — use an application-owned sequence with explicit current-step semantics.

Button.summary: Action button with primary, secondary, outline and ghost styles.
whenToUse: Trigger an action or event — submit, confirm, open a dialog.
whenNotToUse: Navigating between pages or URLs — use a native anchor or router link.
constraints: Content is children, not label. Variants use style, not variant. Sizes are small/medium, not sm/lg. style is a variant string, not a CSS object. Native button events, attributes and ref are forwarded.
The leadingIcon slot owns direct SVG sizing: 16px for small, 20px for medium. Use Phosphor components, not text glyphs.

Button Group.summary: Layout group for related Button instances.
whenToUse: Keep related actions together using existing Button children.
whenNotToUse: Exclusive selection: use RadioGroup or ToggleGroup.
Page navigation: use native anchors or router links.

Calendar.summary: Month calendar supporting single-date and date-range selection in compact and comfortable densities.
whenToUse: Pick a date, or a start and end pair, where the calendar context matters.
whenNotToUse: A date the user knows by heart, such as a birthdate — a plain text field is faster.
Coarse periods like a month or quarter — offer a NativeSelect.
constraints: Controlled month and selection. onSelect emits one Date; the caller owns assembling a range. English weekday names and Sunday week start are currently fixed; monthLabel alone does not localize the grid.

Card.summary: Content container for related information and actions.
whenToUse: Group related content and actions about a single subject.
whenNotToUse: Primary page layout scaffolding.
A bare list of text.
constraints: href makes the whole card a link. Keep nested actions outside an interactive card to avoid nested interactive elements; use a static card with explicit links/buttons otherwise.

Chart.summary: Token-bound chart container for compact documentation and dashboard examples.
whenToUse: Reveal a pattern, comparison, or trend that a table would bury.
whenNotToUse: Precise values the reader needs to read off exactly — use a table.
A single number — use a stat or a Badge.
constraints: Presentation wrapper, not a charting engine. Supply the renderer, data and textual takeaway; use approved chart token roles for series colours.

Checkbox.summary: Controlled labelled checkbox for independent form choices.
whenToUse: NativeSelect one or more independent choices applied on Save or submit; represent partial group selection with indeterminate.
whenNotToUse: An immediate boolean setting: use Switch.
Mutually exclusive options: use RadioGroup.
constraints: Use checked and onCheckedChange, not value. Indeterminate is the string 'indeterminate'; a click resolves it to a boolean.

Collapsible.summary: Single disclosure region for optional controls or secondary information.
whenToUse: Let the reader collapse secondary content so the page stays scannable.
whenNotToUse: Content the reader almost always needs — show it instead of hiding it.
Switching between peer views — use Tabs.

Command.summary: Option anatomy for a command interface; not a complete palette.
whenToUse: Render an option inside an approved command-interface owner that supplies search, keyboard navigation and activation.
whenNotToUse: A ready-made command palette: none is exported.
A fixed action list: use DropdownMenu. A form choice: use NativeSelect.
Command.prefer: No complete command palette is exported.
constraints: An option primitive only. A parent must implement search, active-descendant navigation and keyboard activation; do not present this as a ready-made command palette.

Data Table.summary: Data-management composition built from Input, Button, Table, and Pagination.
whenToUse: Present records across shared columns, for comparison, scanning, or exact reading.
whenNotToUse: Page layout — use a grid.
A handful of key-value pairs — use a description list.
constraints: Composition shell, not a data engine. Caller owns filtering, sorting, pagination and data fetching. Pass empty={rows.length===0} for an opaque Table child. Supply loading/error explicitly.

Date Picker.summary: Controlled single-date or tuple-range selection with a calendar popup and native date-entry fields.
whenToUse: Pick a date, or a start and end pair, where the calendar context matters.
whenNotToUse: A date the user knows by heart, such as a birthdate — a plain text field is faster.
Coarse periods like a month or quarter — offer a NativeSelect.
constraints: Discriminated interface: single uses Date, range uses [Date, Date?]; match the callback to mode. Open state is internal. Native date fields support typing. There is no public min/max/isDisabled prop; request an extension when date restrictions are required.

Dialog.summary: General-purpose modal surface for focused tasks and forms.
whenToUse: Interrupt for a focused task, or a decision that blocks the flow.
whenNotToUse: Non-critical messages — use Alert.
constraints: type is content classification exposed as data-type; both types use Heading/LG. size controls width. Compose body/footer through slots.

Drawer.summary: Modal side surface for a focused secondary task.
whenToUse: Present contextual controls or a focused task in a modal edge panel.
whenNotToUse: Persistent nonblocking content: use an application layout region.
Nonblocking feedback: use Alert.
constraints: Modal side surface. Currently shares behavior/visual language with Sheet; neither is a persistent nonmodal panel.

Dropdown Menu.summary: Controlled action menu with keyboard navigation and linked-trigger positioning.
whenToUse: Offer actions from a trigger when showing all actions would crowd the view.
whenNotToUse: A primary form-choice control: use NativeSelect or RadioGroup. Checkable menu items support secondary menu settings.
Primary navigation: use NavigationMenu or Sidebar.
constraints: Pair id with DropdownMenuTrigger controls, and conditionally mount from shared open state. Unique ids are required. A linked menu portals and positions itself; an unlinked menu is inline. Use nested SubTrigger/SubContent with matching controls/id.

Dropdown Menu / Checkbox Item.summary: Checkable menu item with unchecked, checked, and indeterminate values plus default, highlighted, and disabled states.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Render inside a menu. checked/onCheckedChange; toggling keeps the menu open.

Dropdown Menu / Content.summary: Unanchored menu anatomy with keyboard navigation.
whenToUse: Provide a menu surface within a composition that owns positioning, trigger wiring and open state.
whenNotToUse: An automatically anchored popup: use DropdownMenu.
constraints: Unanchored menu surface. Keyboard behavior is present, but side/align do not anchor the surface to a trigger.

whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Render inside DropdownMenu or DropdownMenuContent so keyboard navigation and activation are provided.
shortcut is visual text only and does not install a keyboard shortcut.

Dropdown Menu / Label.summary: Non-focusable group label with standard or inset alignment.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Noninteractive label inside a menu; it is not a selectable action.

Dropdown Menu / Radio Item.summary: Menu option whose caller owns exclusive checked state.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Render inside a menu. Caller owns exclusive selection and checked state; onSelect invokes the choice.

Dropdown Menu / Sub Content.summary: Nested menu surface anchored to its linked submenu trigger.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Pair id with its SubTrigger controls. Selection dismisses the ancestor popup chain. Caller should clear child open states when removing the parent.

Dropdown Menu / Sub Trigger.summary: Submenu trigger with closed, open, highlighted, and disabled states plus optional inset alignment.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Use inside a menu, with shared open state and controls matching SubContent.id. Parent menu provides keyboard navigation.

Dropdown Menu / Trigger.summary: Controlled trigger button linked to a DropdownMenu by controls/id.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Share controlled open state with conditional menu mounting. controls must match the menu id; use a unique id per instance.

Field.summary: Label, control and validation composition using a render-prop child.
whenToUse: Wrap a form control with its label, helper text, and error message as one unit.
whenNotToUse: A bare control that is already labelled by its surroundings.
Page layout — it composes one field, not a form.
constraints: Render-prop composition: spread the supplied control props into Input, Textarea, NativeSelect or Select. Field owns label, required marker, error and description wiring; the child owns value and onChange.
Pass errorMessage to Field only, not also to the child control. Spread all supplied control props so invalid styling, required state and description links stay connected.

Hover Card.summary: Contextual preview surface revealed on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
whenToUse: Preview the thing behind a link on hover, without making the reader navigate.
whenNotToUse: Content the user needs — hover is unavailable on touch and to many keyboard users.
Anything required to complete a task.
constraints: Optional supplementary information only. Trigger must forward events/ref. Essential information needs a visible or explicit click-accessible path, particularly on touch devices.

whenToUse: Collect a single line of free-form text.
whenNotToUse: Choosing from a fixed set — use NativeSelect or RadioGroup.
Long multi-line text — use Textarea.
constraints: Controlled: supply value and onChange. Use Field for visible labels and validation. Standalone controls need a linked label or aria-label; a placeholder is not a label.

whenToUse: Name a form control, so it is identifiable before and after it is filled.
whenNotToUse: Helper text, format hints, or validation messages — those are separate elements.
A section heading — use a heading.
constraints: requirement is a decorative marker only. Set required or aria-required on the linked control; disabled only dims the label.

whenToUse: Choose one option from a fixed list using the platform menu; supply an accessible label.
whenNotToUse: Free-form input: use Input.
A short visible choice list: use RadioGroup.
Multiple selection, search or rich option content: these are not exposed by this component; compose existing controls or request an extension.
Consistent below-field popup styling: use Select.
constraints: Controlled native select. Its open state belongs to the browser; do not pass open or implement a second popup.
The inset Phosphor indicator is decorative. The native popup's placement and styling belong to the browser/OS; use Select when a consistently anchored popup is required.

Navigation Menu.summary: Flat navigation links with a controlled compact toggle.
whenToUse: Present top-level destinations with desktop and compact layouts.
whenNotToUse: Nested navigation groups: this interface has no nested item shape.
Actions: use DropdownMenu.
constraints: Links come from items. Supply open/onOpenChange for the compact toggle. This is not the similarly named shadcn/Radix primitive interface.

Pagination.summary: Navigate paged datasets or long collections.
whenToUse: Break a long result set into pages the reader can move through and return to.
whenNotToUse: A feed meant to be browsed continuously — use infinite scroll or a load-more control.
Result sets short enough to show at once.
constraints: Pages are 1-based. pageCount is total pages, not item count. Narrow containers show Previous/Next and a summary; wide ones show a bounded page window.

Popover.summary: Controlled anchored interactive popup with optional modal focus management.
whenToUse: Show secondary content or a small task in context, anchored to its trigger.
whenNotToUse: A decision that must block the flow — use a Dialog.
A plain text hint — use a Tooltip.
A list of actions — use a menu.
constraints: Use for anchored interactive content. Supply open/onOpenChange and a single trigger that forwards props and ref (Button or a native element). modal owns focus containment, outside inertness and scroll lock. Placement may flip at edges.

Popover / Arrow.summary: Pointing Arrow for all four popup sides.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Decorative arrow only. Anchored Popover uses its positioning engine's arrow.

Popover / Backdrop.summary: Visual scrim anatomy; modality is owned by Popover.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Visual scrim only. mode does not implement a focus trap; Popover owns modality.

Popover / Close.summary: Explicit close control for Popover content.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Close button only; wire onClose to its parent state.

Popover / Content.summary: Unanchored presentation surface without popup behavior.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Unanchored presentation surface only. side/align are geometry metadata; this export does not provide positioning, dialog semantics, dismissal or focus management.

Popover / Trigger.summary: Controlled button for opening or closing a Popover.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Controlled button. Prefer passing Button to Popover; this trigger can also compose with Popover without duplicating state changes.

Popover / Viewport.summary: Presentation viewport that hides and inerts previous content.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Previous content stays inert and invisible. This surface is not an animation engine or a focus manager.

whenToUse: Show that work is underway, and how far along it is when that is known.
whenNotToUse: Waits short enough that the indicator flashes — show nothing.
Content-shaped placeholders while a view loads — use Skeleton.
constraints: Omit value for indeterminate progress; 0 is determinate. For determinate progress supply a finite value from 0 to a positive finite max (default 100).

Radio Group.summary: Controlled group of native radios for one-of-many selection.
whenToUse: NativeSelect one option from a visible set of mutually exclusive choices.
whenNotToUse: Independent multiple choices: use Checkbox.
An immediate boolean setting: use Switch.
constraints: Supply label, items, value and onValueChange. RadioGroup owns native radio semantics and keyboard behavior; anatomy exports do not.

Radio Group / Indicator.summary: Checked-state indicator nested inside RadioGroup / Item.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer RadioGroup for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use RadioGroup.
constraints: Decorative checked dot only.

Radio Group / Item.summary: Decorative radio circle with visual state previews.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer RadioGroup for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use RadioGroup.
constraints: Decorative circle, aria-hidden, not an interactive radio input.

Radio Group / Root.summary: Presentation fieldset; child controls own exclusive selection.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer RadioGroup for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use RadioGroup.
constraints: Presentation fieldset only. Does not own value, onValueChange or exclusive selection; children supply controls. disabled disables descendant native controls and dims the legend; invalid/readOnly do not propagate visual state to children.

Scroll Area.summary: Named focusable scroll region using native scrollbars.
whenToUse: Confine overflow to one region so the page itself does not scroll.
whenNotToUse: The main page scroll — leave that to the browser.
Hiding content the reader is unlikely to look for.

Segmented Tab.summary: Single tab item for a Tabs-owned tablist and panel.
whenToUse: Switch between peer views of the same subject, within one context.
whenNotToUse: Steps in a sequence — use an application-owned sequence with explicit current-step semantics.
Content the reader needs to compare side by side, or to find with the browser's search.
Navigating to a different page — use links.
constraints: One tab item, not a complete tablist. Tabs supplies group keyboard navigation and linked panels. Standalone items require a tablist owner, roving focus and aria-controls/id wiring.

Separator.summary: Visual separator for grouping adjacent content.
whenToUse: Mark a boundary between groups that spacing alone does not make clear.
whenNotToUse: Where whitespace already separates the groups.
Decoration, or as a border around a region.

Sheet.summary: Modal edge-attached surface for a focused secondary task.
whenToUse: Present a focused task in a modal panel attached to a viewport edge.
whenNotToUse: Persistent nonblocking content: use an application layout region.
Nonblocking feedback: use Alert.
constraints: Modal dialog surface, not a persistent nonblocking sidebar. Use a layout region for persistent adjacent content.

Sidebar.summary: Application sidebar with desktop and compact structures.
whenToUse: Keep navigation persistently in view alongside the main content.
whenNotToUse: Fewer than about five destinations — a horizontal bar reads faster.
Page content or filters that belong in the main column.
constraints: collapsed propagates to SidebarNavigationItem. Application shell owns responsive placement and route state; this is not a mobile drawer.

Sidebar Navigation Item.summary: Navigation item with Sidebar-owned collapse state.
whenToUse: A single destination within sidebar navigation.
whenNotToUse: Firing an action rather than navigating — use a Button.
constraints: Use inside Sidebar for collapse propagation. active is route state, not a Figma state enum. Supply the actual destination or action appropriate to the exported props.

Skeleton.summary: Loading placeholders for text, avatar rows, cards, and table rows.
whenToUse: Hold the shape of content that is loading, so the layout does not jump when it arrives.
whenNotToUse: Waits short enough that it flashes.
Work with a known duration or total — use Progress.
An error or an empty result — those need their own states.
constraints: The component owns a status region; its shapes are aria-hidden. Use one meaningful loading announcement per region rather than duplicating nested announcements.

whenToUse: Pick from a continuous or coarsely stepped range where the relative position matters more than the exact figure.
whenNotToUse: A precise value the user knows — use a number input.
Ranges so wide that a pixel is worth many units.
Fewer than about five discrete options — use radios or a segmented control.

Switch.summary: Controlled labelled switch for an immediate boolean setting.
whenToUse: An independent boolean setting that takes effect immediately.
whenNotToUse: A choice applied after Save or submit: use Checkbox.
Exclusive options: use RadioGroup. An action command: use Button.
constraints: Use checked and onCheckedChange. This is the interactive labelled control; SwitchRoot is only its visual track.

Switch / Root.summary: Decorative switch track with visual state previews.
whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer Switch for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use Switch.
constraints: Visual span only, not a focusable switch. The state enum previews appearance, not independent runtime conditions.

whenToUse: Inspect or compose visual anatomy under an owner that provides the full control semantics; prefer Switch for application work.
whenNotToUse: A standalone interactive control: use Switch.
constraints: Visual thumb only. Match the size of its track; no keyboard or pointer behavior is provided.

Table.summary: Jake UI extension for structured tabular data with compact and comfortable density variants plus optional selected-row treatment.
whenToUse: Present records across shared columns, for comparison, scanning, or exact reading.
whenNotToUse: Page layout — use a grid.
A handful of key-value pairs — use a description list.
constraints: Use native thead/tbody/tfoot with TableRow, TableHead and TableCell; TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter are not exported components. Table density propagates to rows.

Table / Action Trigger.summary: Icon-only row-action trigger used with Dropdown Menu.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Supply a context-specific label and onClick. This button does not anchor a menu by itself; DropdownMenuTrigger provides controls/id pairing for anchored menus.

Table / Caption.summary: Accessible descriptive caption for a table.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Place first inside the native table, before thead/tbody. Use either Table.caption or one TableCaption child, not both.

Table / Cell.summary: Semantic table data cell with alignment and text-emphasis options.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Body cell. Content is children, not value. Use emphasis='strong' selectively.

Table / Container.summary: Responsive overflow wrapper used by the Table root.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Overflow wrapper only. Table already includes it; avoid nesting two scroll containers. If using the anatomy directly, provide a named native table with caption and semantic sections.

whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Header cell. Content is children, not label.

Table / Row.summary: Table row patterns for header, body, and footer sections.
whenToUse: Only inside its parent component's composition — this is a part, not a standalone component.
whenNotToUse: On its own, outside the parent that owns its behaviour and accessibility wiring.
As a general-purpose layout or text primitive.
constraints: Inside a table only. For selection supply selected/onSelect; nested action buttons do not select the row.

Tabs.summary: Grouped navigation for switching between peer views without leaving the current context.
whenToUse: Switch between peer views of the same subject, within one context.
whenNotToUse: Steps in a sequence — use an application-owned sequence with explicit current-step semantics.
Content the reader needs to compare side by side, or to find with the browser's search.
Navigating to a different page — use links.
constraints: Complete controlled tablist and panels. Supply items, selectedId and onSelect; the component composes SegmentedTab and owns group keyboard navigation.

Textarea.summary: Multiline text input for longer freeform content.
whenToUse: Collect free-form text long enough to need more than one line.
whenNotToUse: A single short value — use Input.
Rich or formatted content — use a rich-text editor, not a plain textarea.
constraints: Controlled: supply value and onChange. Use Field for label and validation wiring.
rows sets a fixed editing viewport; long content scrolls and user resizing is disabled. maxLength adds a described character counter, not a per-keystroke live announcement.

Toggle.summary: Two-state action button for formatting, view controls, or other reversible selections.
whenToUse: A reversible on/off action that takes effect immediately — bold, mute, pin, show grid.
Use the group form when several such actions belong together in a toolbar.
whenNotToUse: A form value that is only applied on Save — use Checkbox or RadioGroup.
One-of-many where the options are the data, not actions — use RadioGroup.
A one-way action that cannot be un-done — use a Button.

Toggle Group.summary: Grouped toggle controls for choosing one or multiple persistent options.
whenToUse: A reversible on/off action that takes effect immediately — bold, mute, pin, show grid.
Use the group form when several such actions belong together in a toolbar.
whenNotToUse: A form value that is only applied on Save — use Checkbox or RadioGroup.
One-of-many where the options are the data, not actions — use RadioGroup.
A one-way action that cannot be un-done — use a Button.

Tooltip.summary: Optional noninteractive explanation on hover or focus.
whenToUse: Clarify an already named control with short, nonessential text.
whenNotToUse: A control's only accessible name or essential instructions: provide a label or visible text.
Interactive content: use Popover.
constraints: Noninteractive, nonessential text only. Trigger must forward events/ref and have its own accessible name. For interactive content use Popover; for a disabled button place guidance on a focusable wrapper or show it inline.

Select.summary: Controlled single-choice select with an anchored, styled listbox.
whenToUse: A plain-text form choice that needs consistent popup styling and field-aligned positioning across desktop browsers.
whenNotToUse: Platform-native mobile pickers: use NativeSelect.
Searchable choices, multiple selection or rich option content: request an extension.
Commands or navigation: use DropdownMenu or navigation components.
constraints: Supply value and onValueChange; this callback receives a string, not NativeSelect's DOM change event. Options need unique nonempty values.
Use Field or a linked label. Spread Field's control props and pass errorMessage to Field only.
Arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and typeahead preview choices. Enter/Space/Tab commit; Escape cancels. Focus stays on the trigger.
The popup opens below with an 8px gap, matches the field width and flips when space is insufficient. Its list scrolls; it does not overlap the field.
name and required participate in native forms through a hidden select. Keep value controlled, including form reset handling. Disabled or wholly unavailable option lists cannot open.
An approved code-only extension; do not invent a Figma node or copy the similarly named API from another library.
